name: Long Course
tagline: Nutrition for the long haul, explained clearly.
description: Long Course is an independent nutrition publication by Yiğit Aslan: evidence based writing on fueling, everyday eating, reading research, and a calmer relationship with food.

author.name: Yiğit Aslan
author.shortBio: Master's candidate and dietetic intern at Viterbo University, BS in Nutritional Sciences and Dietetics from UW Madison, Olympic swimmer and former NCAA Division I athlete. Not a registered dietitian or licensed clinician.
